about: What can be bought, and where (docs/design/11-items.md). Shared by the server (server/content/items.go), which sells and keeps what each character owns, and the game (src/game/), which shows the shops and what a player has. An item is bought once; grants are capabilities (archetypes.json) the owner has from then on. Prices are whole xu, shown as đồng (1 xu = 1 đồng); big things (phones, bikes) have game prices, small things real ones (docs/design/10-story.md, section 11). A bike has a vehicle (vehicles.json) that is parked beside its owner; the uniform needs capabilities (requires). A shop may let its customers bargain (haggle: a dialogue signal takes a percent off the next purchase there). fees are paid each time and never owned: paying gives the capabilities in grants (a ticket), and the server checks requires_caps and unless_caps (docs/design/13-driver.md). Of several phones, the one in hand is the last owned in this file's order. Ids are stable: characters store them.

about.vi: Lệ phí thi lần đầu: một buổi thi lý thuyết rồi thi thực hành.
about.en: The first-time fee: a theory test, then the practical.

about.vi: Rớt thì thi lại, lệ phí rẻ hơn: một lần thi nữa.
about.en: Fail and you retake it for less: one more attempt.

about.vi: Cục gạch huyền thoại: gọi điện, nhắn tin, pin xài cả tuần. Không có Crab, không có camera.
about.en: The legendary brick: calls, texts, and a battery that lasts all week. No Crab, no camera.

about.vi: Máy cũ, hơi trầy nhưng còn zin: đủ mọi ứng dụng, đặt Crab được.
about.en: Second-hand and a little scratched, but all original: every app, Crab included.

about.vi: Đời mới hơn, chạy mượt hơn: đủ mọi ứng dụng.
about.en: A newer model that runs more smoothly: every app.

about.vi: Máy xịn nhất tiệm, để khoe. Chạy Crab cũng không nhanh hơn đâu nha!
about.en: The fanciest phone in the shop, for showing off. It won't make your Crab rides any faster!

about.vi: Xe zin, máy êm ru, chạy chục năm chưa hư! Cần có bằng A1 mới chạy được.
about.en: All original, a smooth engine, ten years and never a breakdown! You need an A1 licence to ride it.

about.vi: Áo vàng, mũ vàng, và tài khoản tài xế trong app Crab Driver. Cần điện thoại thông minh, bằng A1 và xe của mình.
about.en: Yellow jacket, yellow helmet and a driver account in the Crab Driver app. You need a smartphone, an A1 licence and a bike of your own.
